description:
Overview

Kemin is a privately held, family-owned company with over 3,300 employees worldwide and manufacturing facilities in Belgium, Brazil, China, India, Italy, Russia, Singapore, South Africa, and the United States. For more than 60 years, Kemin has focused on applying science to improve quality of life, producing over 500 specialty ingredients for humans and animals in the feed, food, health, nutrition, and textile sectors. Kemin serves customers in over 120 countries. The vaccine business is a strategic priority for Kemin. Vaccine innovation is a core part of Kemin’s long-term strategy for growth in animal health.

Regional Technical Service Manager, Poultry (LATAM & Africa)

The Regional Technical Service Manager (TSM) focuses on Latin America & Africa and will operate within the marketing department. The Regional TSM is responsible for the marketing, technical and scientific support of the regional marketing and sales teams regarding our global poultry vaccine platforms. As part of a global team you contribute to strategically drive and support Kemin’s vaccine business across the globe by leveraging and scaling the local Kemin expertise and insights on a global scale.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for leading our poultry vaccine platforms in the LATAM and Africa regions.
  • Drive the strategic marketing and technical support for our poultry vaccine platforms.
  • Analyze market developments and shares in LATAM and Africa and provide a strategy to maintain or reach the Top 10 players for the key market segments in which we participate.
  • Develop robust regional technical and marketing plans.
  • Design and implement the “Go to Market” strategy at a regional level for LATAM and Africa.
  • Oversee Brand life cycles from a strategic planning perspective and work on “Renovation” or “Innovation” to extend the product life cycle, including the planning of field studies to support these efforts within the regions and product launching activities.
  • Actively work on publications and publication strategies relevant to the regions.
  • Involve key thought and market leaders from LATAM and Africa to support the positioning of our platforms and transfer these insights to our teams.
  • Translate relevant regional field issues and customer challenges in poultry health into solutions to support our local sales, technical, and marketing teams and ultimately our customers.
  • Participate in and attend local and regional exhibitions, seminars, trainings, and workshops within LATAM and Africa.
  • Support R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams where needed, by collecting technical information and trial results from the regions.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Veterinary Medicine, ideally with a specialization in poultry health.
  • Field experience managing the health status of poultry, preferably with experience in the LATAM and/or Africa markets.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with an understanding of customer needs in diverse cultural contexts.
  • Excellent writing skills (English) and the ability to provide adequate synthesis.
  • A high degree of personal motivation, a desire to make an immediate contribution, and a sense of urgency.
  • Experience working effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Fluent in English. Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, or French is highly desirable to effectively cover the LATAM and Africa regions.
  • A track record in regional technical or marketing management.
  • Experience in a technical/commercial business in animal health with a focus on poultry.

Working Conditions

  • You will be home office based or based at one of our regional headquarters and will travel across the globe (50% of your time annually).

What Is In It For You

  • Join a highly motivated and truly global team that is rapidly expanding its footprint in the vaccine industry.
  • Continued learning opportunities - Kemin recently launched a corporate university with online and in-person training opportunities for growth and development throughout your entire career.
  • The chance to give back to our world - Through our foundation of servant leadership, we are proud to offer ample service opportunities. Kemin has a valued corporate partnership with both The World Food Program and Habitat for Humanity, in addition to many local initiatives.
  • A competitive financial package - in addition to your salary, we offer an uncapped bonus opportunity and fringe additional benefits.

description:
Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer for our CARE - Deep Individual Data team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil .

Join our growing CARE (Coach on Artificial Intelligence for Real Engagement) team at Wellhub and help us build the next generation of AI-powered solutions. This role focuses on organizing and leveraging digital information about users and people to enhance user experience and recommendations. This project involves collecting user data from various sources in multiple formats (photo, video, text, audio). You will be instrumental in processing, analyzing, and utilizing this data to improve the user experience, user recommendations, business insights, and overall platform quality. Such candidates must be avid learners and be prepared to learn quickly. We use data and software engineering principles to solve large-scale production challenges. Our infrastructure is completely in the cloud, running many more cutting-edge projects.

YOUR IMPACT

  • You will develop and maintain data models and structures that enable efficient querying and analysis;
  • You will design, develop, and maintain data pipelines to transform and process large volumes of data from various sources, while adding business context and semantics to the data;
  • You will implement automated data quality checks to guarantee data quality and consistency across the whole data life cycle.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have created robust and scalable data models from business requirements
  • You have worked collaboratively to collect, prepare and analyze complex business data
  • You can engage engineering and product teams to elicit requirements and present solutions to top management
  • Knowledge of data pipeline tools and technologies (e.g., Airflow, EMR, Kafka).
  • You can collaborate with different teams to understand data needs and develop effective data pipelines
  • You are comfortable understanding big data concepts to ingest, process, and make data available for data scientists, business analysts, and product teams
  • You are comfortable maintaining data consistency across the entire data ecosystem
  • You are motivated to contribute to a data-driven culture and see the impact of your work reflected company-wide

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. For this specific role, prior experience in Data Modeling and Data Pipelines is a mandatory requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • We are a wellness company committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs.
  • WELLHUB: Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. The Gold plan is provided at no cost, and other premium plans are significantly discounted.
  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: Flexible First company with options for flexible hybrid or full remote work. Office is for collaboration and team building. Home office stipend and monthly flexible work allowance are provided.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility to adjust working hours based on personal schedule and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF: Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off per year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Opportunities for personal and career growth with a growth mindset and investment in employee development.
  • CULTURE: A supportive, diverse, and ambitious global team; information available on our careers page.

description:
Overview

Quem é Stone Tech? A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Sênior Data Engineer

Estamos buscando pessoas engenheiras de dados com background e expertise na área, criativas, com energia, comprometidas, que saiba trabalhar bem em equipe, com foco de resolver o problema do cliente com muita qualidade e que queiram encarar conosco o desafio de fazer parte do time de tecnologia responsável pelo Crédito da Stone.

Nosso produto está na rua a todo vapor e queremos escalar ainda mais nosso produto ampliando a sua capacidade, aproveitando todo seu potencial e melhorar ainda mais os pilares técnicos e de eficiência. Nosso produto tem interação com diversas fontes de dados importantes e cruciais para a vida do ciclo de crédito, sejam nossos dados internos cadastrais e transacionais, dados de provedores externos sobre endividamento, restritivo, rede de relacionamento, garantias e os diversos dados internos da companhia. Integrar, transformar e disponibilizar esses dados não é uma tarefa fácil e com todo volume que temos o desafio se torna ainda maior. Pra continuar no caminho certo, precisamos das melhores pessoas, que saibam contribuir bem em time e trabalhar sem ego, afinal, só como um time temos grandes resultados!

Importante lembrar que o nosso desafio requer pessoas com pensamentos de processar dados, construindo processos de qualidade e dispostas a construir sistemas altamente escaláveis e resilientes.

Junto Ao Time, Você Será Responsável Por

  • Você irá compor um time de alta performance com o foco em: projetar, desenvolver, testar, implantar, manter e melhorar o processos de engenharia de dados com foco em solucionar problemas reais dos nossos clientes;
  • Auxiliar na construção de soluções com visão de longo prazo e muita qualidade;
  • Você será um defensor das boas práticas, nossos acordos e processos, revisões, testes e documentações dentro do seu time e influenciar esta cultura o máximo possível;
  • É esperado de você extrema facilidade de trabalho em equipe, muita franqueza e transparência para que no dia-a-dia possa ter ótimo relacionamento com o time e transmitir conhecimento;
  • Aqui todos possuem a mente aberta para trabalhar com qualquer tecnologia, muita vontade de aprender e entregar resultado, além de ser apaixonado por tecnologia e sistemas de alta performance;

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência em linguagem de desenvolvimento para ferramentas e rotinas de Data Engineering (Python, Java, Scala ou outras);
  • Processo de Data Quality / qualidade e testes para Engenharia de Dados;
  • Conhecimentos sobre BigQuery / Datalake;
  • Conhecimentos de processamento com Databricks / ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Experiência com operação de serviços na nuvem;

O Que Aumenta As Suas Chances

  • Conhecimentos de negócio de Crédito e Risco;
  • Conhecimento de provedores de dados como SCR, Boa Vista (BVS), Serasa etc;
  • Experiência em projetos voltados para a área financeira;
  • Experiência com aplicações críticas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias em geral é sempre um diferencial;

Nossos Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

A Nova Escola tem a missão de fortalecer os educadores para transformar a educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.
A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil.

Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. 64% dos professores brasileiros utilizam nossos planos de aula todos os meses, além disso temos 3 milhões de visitantes únicos por mês em nossa plataforma e cerca de 1,8 milhões de seguidores em nossas redes sociais, o que nos permite conhecer bem nosso público.
Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!
Responsibilities and assignments
Criamos o Banco de Talentos da Nova Escola para que profissionais que tenham o desejo de transformar a educação junto com a gente, possam demonstrar o seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso nosso negócio.

Desde já agradecemos seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time!

Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.
Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.
Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Atitude Responsável: Para nós, agir com responsabilidade é uma prática contínua, tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação. Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.
Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazer perguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimorar nossos processos.

What's cool about this job

At Turing, you won’t just guide product development—you’ll shape the tools that power our business. We’re looking for an accomplished Enterprise Product Manager to lead the vision and strategy for our custom internal tooling ecosystem. In this role, you’ll partner closely with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to design and deliver solutions that streamline workflows, increase efficiency, and enable our teams to operate at scale. Your work will directly impact how our global teams collaborate, make decisions, and deliver value to internal customers—transforming complex internal processes into seamless, intuitive experiences.

The day to day

  • Collaborate with Business leaders and fellow Product Managers to understand Turing’s enterprise product strategy and the essential role your internal tooling team plays in enabling it.
  • Own the end-to-end experience for the internal systems and tools your team delivers, ensuring they drive efficiency, reliability, and scalability across the organization.
  • Translate complex technical concepts about our tooling infrastructure into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
  • Continuously refine and prioritize your product roadmap based on deep user research, data-driven insights, and input from business stakeholders—balancing trade-offs to deliver the highest organizational value.
  • Write clear, high-quality epics and user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria, delivering capabilities that empower teams to work more independently and reduce reliance on manual support.
  • Partner closely with engineering leadership to align technical direction with product goals, integrating both into the roadmap and backlog with precision.
  • Work hand-in-hand with your engineering team in an Agile environment to design, plan, and deliver impactful internal tooling solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product, Program Management, and Operations teams to clarify scope, dependencies, and technical requirements for each initiative.
  • Define measurable product success metrics to track adoption, performance, and impact of your tools across the business.
  • Build trust and rapport with teams across the organization, fostering strong partnerships that ensure alignment and shared success.

Your skills and expertise

  • Experience that Delivers: 7+ years of progressive product management experience in a technical environment, ideally building or managing internal platforms, automation systems, or enterprise-scale tools.
  • Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a technology-focused discipline such as Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Mathematics, or Business.
  • Professional Credentials: Product Management and/or Product Owner certifications (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, Pragmatic Institute Certified Product Manager) a plus.
  • Systems & Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with DevOps, internal platform engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices.
  • User-First Mindset: Proven ability to deeply understand internal user workflows and organizational pain points (the “why”) before defining and prioritizing solutions (the “what”).
  • Agile Practitioner: Strong working knowledge and hands-on experience with modern software delivery approaches (Scrum, Agile, Iterative, Incremental).
  • Clear Communicator: Exceptional ability to explain product goals, technical requirements, and strategic priorities to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Execution-Focused Leader: High attention to detail and a history of successfully managing multiple, competing priorities from concept to delivery.
  • Collaborative Partner: A track record of building strong cross-functional relationships and actively engaging with engineering, operations, and business teams to deliver impactful outcomes.

Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to embedded. And we continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.

description:
Overview

Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid-to-senior-level role with potential people management responsibilities. The CSM will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You will work across departments to deliver a high-quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM): serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision-makers across large multinational organizations.
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.
  • Customer Implementations: lead end-to-end delivery of onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams to deliver on time and to spec.
  • Map customer-specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
  • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.
  • Renewal & Retention Management: own renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for allocated customers and region.
  • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
  • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem-solving.
  • Strategic Account Growth: identify and support growth opportunities, including cross-sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
  • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts to enable account expansion.
  • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement and evolving needs.
  • Platform Mastery & Support: develop deep expertise across Libryo’s tools (Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, ERM Assess) and deliver high-level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms.
  • Ensure a consistent, professional, and high-quality user experience across touchpoints.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: collaborate with Legal, Product, Support, and Customer Intelligence to deliver seamless service; participate in health reviews and product feedback loops; may mentor junior CSMs.
  • Customer Reporting & Communication: deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight and platform metrics; maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot; contribute to internal reporting (churn forecasting, health scores, dashboards).

Experience & Qualifications

  • Fluent in English; additional languages (especially Spanish) are a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or related discipline. A legal background is advantageous.
  • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal-tech, or ESG space.
  • Proven track record managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving growth and renewals.
  • Experience leading complex customer implementations, cross-functional projects, and senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Exposure to international accounts with understanding of NA/LATAM contexts and cultural nuances.
  • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
  • Experience mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered.
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned accounts.
  • On-time delivery of onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Data-driven QBRs with current insights shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self-service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end-to-end journey. Help refine internal processes to improve delivery quality across customer segments.

Thank you for your interest in ERM!

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Vem trabalhar com a gente. Vem ser Cora!

Sobre a Cora

Das 21 milhões de empresas do Brasil, 93% são pequenos e médios negócios e, apesar de serem responsáveis por ⅓ do PIB do país e 60% dos empregos, as PMEs não são o foco da maioria das instituições financeiras. Isso muda com a Cora, banco digital criado exclusivamente para apoiar PMEs. Com 5 anos de existência, já somamos mais de 1 milhão de clientes e 300 pessoas trabalhando de forma remota em vários lugares do Brasil.

Dia a dia como Product Marketing Manager na Cora

  • Atuação de ponta a ponta: ser a voz de Marketing em todas as etapas de criação de um produto, do discovery ao acompanhamento no ciclo de vida;
  • Integração com stakeholders: atuar como ponte entre Marketing, Produto e áreas estratégicas como Dados, Crédito e CX;
  • Discovery e posicionamento: contribuir na definição de problemas, oportunidades e posicionamento de produto desde as fases iniciais;
  • Go-to-Market: liderar iniciativas de lançamento de produtos e funcionalidades-chave, garantindo comunicação clara e impacto de negócio;
  • Gestão do ciclo de vida: acompanhar métricas de produto (adoção, engajamento, retenção) para propor melhorias contínuas;

Quem estamos buscando

Uma pessoa com:

  • Mão na massa: perfil prático, com capacidade de entregar em um cenário ainda em construção e construir suas atribuições com o passar do tempo;
  • Trabalho em conjunto: colaboração intensa com PMs, Product Designers, time de Marketing, engenharia e outras áreas estratégicas;
  • Comunicação estruturada: clareza para traduzir visão de produto em mensagens consistentes para diferentes públicos;
  • Gestão de stakeholders: habilidade para navegar em times multifuncionais, conciliando prioridades e garantindo buy-in;
  • Liderança por influência: Capacidade comprovada de liderar esforços em times transversais, sem relação de subordinação;
  • Visão analítica: conhecimento de métricas de marketing e produto para embasar decisões (ex: CAC, LTV, PMF, NPS e outras);
  • Experiência prévia: pelo menos 3–4 anos em Product Marketing, com histórico em discovery, GTM e gestão de ciclo de vida. Experiência prévia em banking/crédito é um diferencial relevante.

Cultura da Cora

Potencializamos o espírito empreendedor e valorizamos quem empreende e vive a nossa Cultura no dia a dia. Precisamos de energia e inconformismo para resolver problemas dos nossos clientes, construindo (muitas vezes do zero) produtos e soluções financeiras simples e acessíveis para ajudar pessoas empreendedoras a tomar decisões informadas de negócio. Buscamos pessoas inconformadas e excelentes no que fazem (levantamos a barra), que trabalhem de forma autônoma e resolutiva (fazemos acontecer), colaborativa (trabalhamos juntos) e empática (pensamos nas pessoas).

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you've enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, which include but are not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms

We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.

Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.

The role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Homeward aims to take the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that buyers and sellers use to get certainty and convenience in the real estate market.   • Work side-by-side with our existing Salesforce experts to own Salesforce implementation and architecture planning
  • Work closely with our engineering team to build integrations & develop processes that scale our operations & sales efforts
  • Wear both light development and administration hats - as a growing organization, we’ll need an administrator who can fill both roles to ensure we plan data structures and configurations for scaling
About You
  • 3+ years of Salesforce administration experience, ideally in a growth business
  • Credentials
    • Required: Salesforce Certified Administrator & Advanced Administrator

  • Incredibly strong ownership of delivering the right solutions at a high quality
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively manage an inbound stream of requests
  • Proven track record of working cross-functionally with stakeholders to communicate and deliver outcomes
  • Experience developing within a highly customized Salesforce environment
  • Ability to be flexible, wear many hats, pivot, and enjoy a dynamic environment
  • Self-starter mentality with experience devising and testing hypotheses and implementing research plans; someone who can help the business identify the right questions to ask

    • LeanData

Value-Driven Employee Experience
THE GOLDEN RULE . It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.
CALM FOCUS . We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.
ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM . Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you\'ll do

The Core+ Support Expert - eSign is the internal voice for our customer base, with accountability and responsibility to deliver on our customers’ needs. This role is the liaison between customers and all functional areas within Docusign to resolve technical support inquiries. Working with resources across Docusign, the Core+ Support Expert expedites the resolution of complex technical issues to empower customers to achieve the highest value and adoption of our software.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Support Service Delivery Manager.

Responsibility

  • Support Docusign Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) and associated services

  • Resoluve escalated cases from support channels involving customer-reported issues

  • Own customer issues requiring engineering engagement to address technical bugs and influence the development roadmap

  • Apply technical product expertise within IAM areas to support customer adoption

  • Utilize support tools and resources, including telephone, Salesforce, Jira, Docusign logging systems, SharePoint, browser developer tools, internal admin console, SQL, and text analysis tools

  • Query languages to gather and track affected documents to further understand customer impact, a.k.a. documents

  • Identify product improvements, bugs, and opportunities to enhance customer experience

  • Promote Docusign products and services through consultative discussions

  • Partner with non-delivery teams to identify training needs and develop content

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, and Account Management to ensure alignment

Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position\'s job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline

  • 2+ years of SaaS troubleshooting experience in a Technical Support capacity

  • Experience modern markup and programming languages such as XML, C#, Python, PHP, JavaScript/jQuery, or similar tools

  • Experience with troubleshooting in a web-based environment, including HTTP, JSON, IIS, HTML, and CSS

  • Experience with log analysis using network tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, Charles Proxy, or other browser/developer tools, or something similar

  • Proven ability to document steps taken to troubleshoot problems through resolution for explanation with any audience, as well as provide updates when a case/ticket has been reviewed, reassigned, and/or escalated

  • Experience with at least one (1) vertical or subject matter associated with Docusign, signing or agreement products, or similar technology supported or used previously

Preferred

  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, real-time troubleshooting

  • Effective communication skills, with audiences that include customers, peers, and occasional executive presence

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, with exceptional organizational, writing, and time management skills

  • Ability to troubleshoot regular expressions and other complex data validation rules

  • Expertise with web-based applications, web service APIs, monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace), and authentication technologies such as SAML and OAuth

  • Familiarity with structured query languages such as SQL and SOQL

  • Ability to maintain composure in critical situations and communicate clearly with both internal and external customers

  • Ability to collaborate with co-workers within the organization and beyond to resolve any situation for our customers, provide help as readily as possible, and obtain assistance as needed

  • Familiarity with basic Docusign Contract Lifecycle and Agreement Management workflows and methodology

  • Speak another language fluently as per the advertised opportunity, Docusign, a.k.a. supported languages

  • Professional experience within relevant industries for which Docusign provides solutions

  • Abillity to work well within a team environment as well as independently

  • Docusign organization administration work experience, or similar knowledge

Life at Docusign

Working here

Who we are?

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

Job Description

In the role, you will work with a dedicated, enthusiastic team developing enhancements to a Laboratory Information Management System (a LIMS) and supporting the LIMS' multiple customers.

Where will you be based and what business will you support?

Brazil

How can you help us?

As a Tech Lead Delphi Developer, you will:

  • Lead Development teams in a local line management capacity reporting to the Software Engineering Manager in Europe
  • Set targets and mentor the team/s locally
  • Ensure quality in team development
  • Participate in sprint planning and sprint retrospective meetings
  • Assign and deliver development tasks requested during sprint planning
  • Estimate the complexity and the workload
  • Choose the most appropriate technical solution to meet the user requirements
  • Design, develop and deploy changes to the LIMS according to the customers’ and business users’ requirements.
  • Support the LIMS in collaboration with the other team members
  • Working together with other team members (Engineers/QA) to ensure high quality of delivered solutions.
  • Ensuring good practices and high quality standards are implemented and followed

Experience

Are you our kind of extraordinary?

  • Experience as a Tech Lead in a local line management capacity
  • 4+ years of experience developing solutions using Embarcadero Delphi 2006 or later (Delphi 12 preferable)
  • Experience with using Delphi to develop Windows Services and/or UI Forms would be a clear bonus
  • 7+ for senior roles years of experience with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong working knowledge on server-side development with Delphi and/or with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Good understanding of relational databases (Oracle 9i, 11c or later)
  • Strong knowledge of Agile software development practices, particularly Scrum and/or Kanban
  • Clear experience in collaboration with Business Analysts and Software Architect(s)
  • Some Experience in test driven development and test automation
  • Comfortable in unit testing and mocking with Delphi
  • Ability to translate functional requirements into technical solutions

Education:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer Science or similar;

As the role and Eurofins' IT Talent Acquisition team are international, please ensure to submit your application in English.

Monday to Friday - 8:00 to 17:00

The new team member, working within the Financial Reporting team, will play a key role in supporting the evolution of financial reporting in a challenging and stimulating environment.   • Strong attention to detail with the ability to provide high-quality work efficiently.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt and work in a quickly changing environment, managing competing demands.

  • Openness to cooperating with many teams in different countries.

description:
Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. O Grupo acredita que é o líder mundial em análises de produtos alimentícios e farmacêuticos, matrizes ambientais e em serviços de CRO de agrosciences. É também um dos líderes de mercados independentes globais para de certos testes e serviços laboratoriais para genômica, pesquisa farmacológica, ciência forense, ciências de materiais avançadas e para apoio a estudos clínicos. Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: Faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Descrição da vaga

Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Realizar e supervisionar as diferentes etapas analíticas, incluindo pesagem, extração e homogeneização, por exemplo;
  • Treinar novos colaboradores e acompanhar auxiliares e estagiários em procedimentos quando solicitado pelo Coordenador do Setor
  • Incluir os resultados avaliados, repetições e análises adicionais no sistema (de acordo com a respectiva linha de negócio), bem como registrar informações pertinentes;
  • Realizar a solicitação de compra de materiais para o laboratório no sistema com supervisão da Coordenação, se necessário;
  • Auxiliar o envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e orientação dos Assistentes, Auxiliares e Estagiários;
  • Revisar e criar novos documentos no sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Participar de forma supervisionada nas validações, no que tange as etapas analíticas;
  • Comunicar com a área de cadastro (Login/Triagem) quanto às amostras em processamento, seguida de impressão de mapa de trabalho. Armazenar essas amostras de forma organizada no setor.
  • Auxiliar na checagem de resultados analíticos / análises críticas;
  • Executar os ensaios de proficiência;
  • Comunicar qualquer problema na rotina do laboratório junto ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação;
  • Realizar as tarefas gerais do laboratório de acordo com a divisão de tarefas definidas pelo Coordenador que pode incluir: preparo de materiais (soluções, tampões, meios de culture, soluções padrão), checagem de temperaturas, validade das soluções e reagentes em uso;
  • Comunicar a necessidade de materiais e necessidade de manutenção corretiva e preventiva dos equipamentos ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação, e quando necessário realizar as manutenções periódicas nos equipamentos seguindo as recomendações do fabricante e as orientações do Analista Sênior ou Coordenador
  • Manter os freezers, geladeiras, armários, gavetas, prateleiras e bancadas organizados, mantendo cada insumo armazenado em temperatura preconizada pelo fabricante (ambiente, refrigerado ou congelado);
  • Limpar e desinfetar a área de trabalho (bancada) antes e depois da rotina, seguindo o procedimento específico;
  • Vistoriar mensalmente os insumos quanto à data de vencimento; informar o Coordenador do Setor com antecedência sobre o vencimento e realizar o descarte quando necessário;
  • Utilizar todos os EPIs necessários para a realização das tarefas com segurança e de acordo com as normas de segurança dos laboratórios;
  • Arquivar documentos de acordo com treinamento da qualidade;
  • Segregar e descartar os resíduos.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade, ou a critério de seu superior.

Qualificações

Necessário experiência com GC/MS ou ICP-OES/MS, de preferência em áreas ambientais.

Inglês intermediário – capaz de se comunicar e compreender, sem necessidade de fluência.

  • A broad design background covering digital, print and events.

  • Fully competent with the latest Adobe Suite, and designing for print, digital and social.
  • A degree in Graphic Design.
  • Strong portfolio of completed design projects that demonstrate strong concept and design delivery.
  • Expert eye for detail and craft.

Our people are important to us, and we understand that each person has a life outside of work and we therefore offer flexible working arrangements aiming to suit your needs. Overview

Aduro Advisors is looking for bright and talented individuals to join our team working to support top-tier clients in the Venture Capital & Private Equity space. We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic VP of Sales and Business Development to build out a strategy to increase our position in the Private Equity market and continued growth of brand in the Venture Capital market.

Why Aduro?

We’re not your typical fund administrators. We’re modern, innovative, and backed by deep industry experience, allowing our clients to focus on investing while we handle the details. We pride ourselves on providing our clients with thoughtful and adaptable service while leveraging best-in-class technology.

We thrive in a people-first culture where each team member can impact the success of the business. We do this by investing heavily in training and development programs, providing ample opportunities for growth, and focusing on fostering a culture of collaboration and community.

Responsibilities

The VP of Sales and Business Development will work alongside our CEO and Executive Team to create a strategy to increase our position within the private equity space, as well as continue growing our existing client base in our established market of venture capital. This person should be a strategic thinker with strong project management skills who can pivot from big picture to hands-on seamlessly. This person should have a proven track record of success and have experience overseeing and building a sales team.

Here is the type of work you will do:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy to meet Aduro's long-term growth revenue objectives that includes but is not limited to:
  • Review of existing sales process and supporting collateral in conjunction with Aduro's Marketing team
  • Development of an Aduro presence and deeper partner relationships within the Private Equity industry
  • Collaboration on event sponsorship strategy and supporting collateral with COO
  • Outbound sales strategy
  • Run an efficient and high-performing BD team including:
  • Review of the existing sales process and development and implementation of a plan to increase effectiveness in line with industry best practices
  • Mentor & support Business Development team achieving their revenue goals
  • Ensure proper team structure & management of team performance
  • Structure and manage a fair and competitive commission structure for the business development team
  • Oversee the management of prospective client data in Salesforce ensuring that it is comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date for recurring weekly pipeline management as well as recurring and ad hoc reporting to the Aduro Executive Team and Board of Directors
  • Ensure effective collaboration and knowledge sharing with the Client Onboarding team to ensure that the Onboarding team has insight into the imminent sales pipeline and sufficient client data to facilitate a seamless and high quality client experience
  • Obtain a deep understanding of the Aduro service offering, FundPanel.io software platform, Aduro client base, and overall competitive landscape to craft a message that is in-line with Aduro's service offering and resonates with potential Aduro clients
  • Collaborate with the CEO and COO on Aduro pricing strategy and provide feedback as to what is 'market' in the industry
  • Travel to attend in-office collaboration meetings with the greater BD team or Executive Leadership team periodically. There is no weekly requirement to be in office, but the VP of Sales and Business Development should use in-person meetings as a tool to run the team effectively as needed.
  • Travel to Business Development-related events such as conferences or event sponsorships is a requirement of this role. Cadence of in-person attendance should average out over time to be monthly but may vary based on specific event needs.

Compensation

The salary range for the VP of Sales and Business Development position is $200,000 - $250,000. Salary is determined based on current market data and candidate experience level. This role is eligible to participate in the Aduro Bonus Program and an employee Equity Plan.

Perks

  • Competitive salary
  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Short-Term Disability
  • Long-Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) & company holidays
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Company-wide social events and programs
  • Dog-friendly office in downtown Denver

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in client-facing roles within the financial services industry, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership position (e.g., Director, VP, Managing Director) on a Business Development Team.
  • Deep and comprehensive understanding of fund administration operations for alternative investment funds (e.g., hedge funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate funds).
  • Proven track record of successfully managing and growing client relationships, demonstrating exceptional client retention and satisfaction.
  • Strong knowledge of financial instruments, investment strategies, and regulatory environments relevant to alternative investments (e.g., SEC, FATCA, CRS).
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (verbal and written), and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and build rapport at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving client challenges.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, complex, and highly regulated environment.

$200,000 - $250,000
